Definition: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
BiblicalUsage: 1) to disturb, alarm, terrify, hurry, be disturbed, be anxious, be afraid, be hurried, be nervous; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be disturbed, dismayed, terrified, anxious; 1a2) to be in haste, be hasty; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to make haste, act hastily, be hurried, be hastened; 1b2) to dismay, terrify; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to hasten; 1c2) hastened, hastily gained (part.); 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to hasten, hurry, make haste; 1d2) to dismay, terrify
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
